overlap_concerns.brightness/clear/day: Check whether all three trend together across images
overlap_concerns.intimacy/lateNight/rain: Intimacy may be conflated with night/rain scene cues
overlap_concerns.motion/desiredSound.energy: High correlation expected; check if one is redundant
overlap_concerns.openness/dreaminess: Both can score high for foggy/expansive scenes
overlap_concerns.acousticness/electronicness: Complementary; sum should not anchor at 50+50
overlap_concerns.motion/climaxIntensity: Motion is visual observation; climaxIntensity is musical inference
overlap_concerns.socialEnergy/groove: High crowd scenes may over-drive groove recommendation

limitations: 25 dimensions scored on visible evidence; desiredSound is inferred, not observed
30-track validation subset — not the full catalog
3 runs is a minimal reproducibility sample
temperature=0 reduces but does not eliminate non-determinism in GPT-4o
Track stat drafts themselves may have errors (statConfidence < 1.0 for several tracks)
No diversity or genre constraint applied — raw similarity only
